newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra's Wartsila seals FIM 580 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Metra's Wartsila seals FIM 580 mln order.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Metra's Wartsila NSD engine-building unit said on Wednesday it had sealed a power plant order worth 580 million markka from Independent Power Tanzania Ltd (IPTL).
"The order value is $114 million (FIM 580 million markka)," Wartsila NSD said in a statement.
"The order is an important reference in the African markets," Wartsila NSD said.
The order was for 10 Wartsila engines for a 100 MW power plant to be built in the Dar es Salaam area and to be operational in July 1998, it said.
The new power plant will provide 15 percent of the total energy generation in Tanzania, it said.
The engines will be built by Wartsila NSD Oy Ab's Dutch subsidiary, Wartsila NSD Nederland, the company said.
